title: Tenma Saki — Cookie Cheer〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our first song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for hearing our very first song! Thank you all very much!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our show was so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We didn't get a standing ovation or anything, and our song still needs a lot of work...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But we took our first really big step as Leo/need!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't for our next show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But for now, I should get some well-deserved rest...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even though I can't wait to keep practicing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm? A message from Ichi?
Directly to me too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... <Can you come to SEKAI now?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Did I forget something?
I don't have anything else to do right now, so why not♪
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, you there?
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Sakki♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hi, Rin!
Did you call her over here too, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. There's something I'd like to give you both.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here, I hope you like them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! These bags are so cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, they are!
Wait, these smell like... Cookies?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Correct. They're my way of thanking you for what you did for me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You brought some for me the other day while I was writing lyrics, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Darn, caught red-handed!
Nothing gets past Detective Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, you did write, “You can do it, Ichi!” on them, so you immediately became my prime suspect.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We actually thought about writing different messages on each cookie but couldn't really get them quite right.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that's why we decided to make it a puzzle by writing just one letter on each cookie♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha☆
Looks like our dying message was a big success♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Rin, that's for when someone dies!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But Saki, Rin...
Really...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for the cookies and the support.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, super duper welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, can we eat these now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna try them too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well...
The idea was to have you enjoy them at home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But they smell so good right now!
It's like they're saying, “Eat us♪”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But, I mean...
Here...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. This is sort of my home anyway, so here I go...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Rin, wait!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no... If I don't eat something now, I might not make it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, look at that! Cookies♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, Saki, you too...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh wow! Sakki, look...!
These cookies have letters written on them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, hang on...!
If you line them up like this, they say, “Thank you!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, they're just like the ones we baked!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, they sort of are...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I don't know what to say!
Thanks, Ichi, you're the best!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wah! Oh, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪
